name: sg-bask
summary: Full-bleed hero running shader.gallery's bask: four warm poles of peach, coral and cream drifting over one another while a dawn glow lifts out of the lower third, with a matched CSS morning as the resting state. The light-ground counterpart to the dark shader heroes.

colors.description: Four poles in quadrant order: lower left, lower right, upper right, upper left. Index 1 also lights the dawn glow along the bottom. Omit to read --fx-c1 through --fx-c4 off the section, which is what keeps the shader and the CSS resting state on one palette.

driftSpeed.description: How fast the colour poles wander; 0 holds the morning still. Upstream default, range 0 to 0.7.

softness.description: Pole influence radius; low keeps tight colour pools, high spreads broad banks. Upstream default, range 0.4 to 2.

dawn.description: Warm glow rising out of the lower third; 0 leaves an even field. Upstream default, range 0 to 1.2.

warp.description: Organic warp on the colour edges, so the poles read as light rather than as circles. Upstream default, range 0 to 1.5.

deviations.what: The four u_palette colours are ours, not upstream's `daybreak` preset.
deviations.why: bask/meta.json names a palette as a string only; the table it resolves against lives in @shader-gallery/runtime, a package paw-fx does not vendor. Ours is a warm daybreak chosen to match the CSS resting state, which reads the same --fx-c1..--fx-c4.

deviations.what: No post chain: upstream's poster runs grain 0.055, vignette 0.18, exposure 1.04 and saturation 1.06 over the shader output.
deviations.why: The post chain is also in @shader-gallery/runtime. Our output is the raw shader, so it will not match the upstream poster. The section's own CSS grain layer covers the banding the poster's grain was there for.

deviations.what: Rendered through paw-fx's own WebGL runtime (effects/_shared/glsl-mount.js) rather than @shader-gallery/runtime.
deviations.why: Seam. Upstream ships the .frag with no module around it. The GLSL itself is byte-identical to upstream and lives in shader.frag beside index.js.
